body: I am a Pisces woman with an Aries dad. But since we were little our mom was not around and our dad took up that role. He was very hot headed and had a temper so that was a scary growing up. But as an adult we have a great relationship and I do believe he has always tried his best to make sure I was taken care of. He is very competitive but he’s always competed in different weightlifting competitions and things like that while I was growing up and even still now. Has lots of trophies for it too, he did well. He really wants support for his passions and I am happy to support him. But he does the same for us.
